## Context / Problem

Bedrock Converse `outputConfig` (native structured output) is rejected CLIENT-SIDE by the
currently locked botocore 1.40.61 (`ParamValidationError` before any network call — measured,
E1 experiment recorded on the selection bug ticket). The wire feature needs botocore >= 1.43.
The lock sits at 1.40.61 because of the declared extras diamond: `[eval]` -> inspect-ai ->
aioboto3 -> aiobotocore caps `boto3 < 1.40.62`, while `pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock]`
(pyproject.toml:250) wants newer; the `[tool.uv]` conflicts block (pyproject.toml, ~line 261)
already forks eval vs bedrock/dev resolution to keep both installable.

## Approach

Add an explicit floor `botocore>=1.43.0` (and matching `boto3>=1.43.0`) alongside the
`pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock]` dependency in pyproject.toml, then `uv lock`. Assumption stated as
default: the existing conflict forks absorb the eval cap exactly as they do today (eval and
bedrock never co-resolve); if the lock proves unresolvable, the fallback is scoping the floor
to the bedrock-carrying extra only. No source change; the capability rows story is what makes
the new wire feature reachable — this ticket is purely the SDK floor.

Purely mechanical dependency bump: no new testable behavior, so no Testing section (the
existing suite gates regressions).

## Scope

- pyproject.toml — the floor declaration
- uv.lock — regenerated

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `uv lock` succeeds with the existing `[tool.uv]` conflicts block unchanged — checked by
      the lock command exiting 0 in-session.
- [x] The dev/bedrock resolution contains botocore >= 1.43 — checked by `uv tree` (or
      `uv pip list`) output recorded in the commit/ticket showing the resolved version.
- [x] The eval fork still resolves (`uv sync --extra eval` exits 0) — checked in-session.
- [x] `make test` passes on the new lock — checked by the CI-gating suite before push.
